title: API Launchpad: Model Selection Flow and Code Composer Screenshots
creator: Arielle Chen
description: Create a compact, developer-focused asset pack for the API Launchpad (hosted API) flow: model selection, request composer, and multi-language code snippets. These assets will be used in docs, product first-run modal, and the console onboarding card. Focus on: clear model metadata (performance, cost, region), an inline request builder with example payloads, and code snippet toggles for curl/python/js that populate from the request composer. Deliver hi-res PNGs and vector exports, plus a Figma page with annotated layout specs and responsive variants.
tasks: Sketch model selection variations: grid (cards) + compact list + single-column mobile
Design request composer states: empty, filled, validation error, streaming response
Create code snippet component with language toggle (curl, python, node) and copy button
Produce final PNGs: desktop@2x, tablet@2x, mobile@3x for each screen
Export SVG assets and provide tokens for spacing/typography to engineering
Write short alt-text and copy variations for docs and in-product use
Upload assets to Drive and add links to PR + docs pages

2025-02-14 Design review (Cross-functional): Iterated on compact list to reduce cognitive load; removed redundant copy and emphasized 'Try sample request' CTA. Preparing final exports.
